validation.sourceScope: CPU-only checks; no new G media or 3D browser was created

cacheCandidates.scope: Read-only precommit cache candidate analysis. Recheck against the final immutable G snapshot; live bytes are not an authorized film source.
Read-only precommit cache candidate analysis. Recheck against the final immutable G snapshot; live bytes are not an authorized film source.

rootApply: Apply the independent official-driver patch only at a safe FIFO interval, then commit the five new runtime helpers plus driver change with the selected scene sources. Provide the exact pushed 40-hex G commit.

artifactPaths.rawClips: <snapshot>/qa/ten-reference/{01..10}/iteration-sol61-rebuild-20261026-g/motion-review.mp4 (reused clips keep their original F paths)

resumePolicy.liveChild: Attach/poll actual PID and journal, never timeout-restart.
resumePolicy.completed: Verify source/sampling/driver/MSAA/encoded SHA/certificate, skip unchanged completed shots.
resumePolicy.orphanComplete: Only recover from all168 successful native journal records plus probed/decoded168-frame existing bitstream; preserve original receipt.
resumePolicy.partial: Preserve and mark attention; no automatic re-render/overwrite.
resumePolicy.failedSnapshot: Preserve partial materialization; do not silently delete/recreate snapshot.

fairness: Every new source shot is one independent official render-one FIFO child; no global GPU lock spans the film.

storage.journal: Minimal per-frame pose/GL/MSAA/hash records, no repeated giant scene info.
storage.reportCompression: Only current-process newly generated terminal G reports before completion publication, using ditto --hfsCompression --noclone with exact raw SHA/path/mode/mtime checks. Reused F and uncertain resumed/shared reports are excluded.
storage.largeMedia: Do not git-add MP4s over100MB; publish concrete final artifacts via a new GitHub release.
storage.automaticCompressionGate: Freshly launched and terminal G-only official child, before completion publication; lsof closed/single link/untracked snapshot file/exact raw SHA/path/mode/mtime checks. No reused F or uncertain resumed reports.

knownReviewLimits: Legacy F02/09 numeric per-pass MSAA was not recorded; reuse carries explicit exact-source/vendor/runtime multisample-contract evidence, not a forged numeric observation.
The proposed observer/journal patch leaves renderShot sample times/readPixels/encoding pixel paths unchanged; actual new main framebuffer MSAA is measured during authorized capture.
Full bitstream decode is technical validation; sampled frame review does not establish every-frame photographic fidelity or absence of every flicker.
